t: Follow Eurial's tracks and find out where she took Skulnar. Report to Louis afterwards.

Eurial?

Hmm, I know her. She's a nasty one. I wonder what she wants with our friend.

Let's find out where they went! We saved Elena on Ferris, we'll save Skulnar!
We've heard rumors that your friend Skulnar disappeared somewhere. We assume this is not the orc's usual behavior the morning after festivities?

Catacombs under the city? Interesting! I've heard about that.

In any event, we need to wait until they clear the rubble.

Hopefully nothing terrible happens in the meantime. We'll tell you once we're done.
The local boatman didn't see anything, I already asked him! But we'll find Skulnar without him.
Let's use our biggest advantage - my nose. I can pick up his trail as soon as you ask me to.
Get past the Kobold King and find the Ritual site

Surface dwellers! Why are you here? That's not your territory! I'm the king here, not you! Zvik!

The Traveler said you'd come! But there's no way forward! You want to pass?

!

We're finally facing each other without masks.
It looks like you've almost figured it out...

A special ritual that will help us all if you do not interfere. I can't tell you the details, but I'm sure Elleken will tell you everything once he's done.

This story has been going on for a thousand years, and soon it will come to an end!

I suggest you don't spill blood needlessly. We are not enemies and not even villains, . It's just that few understand... our goals.

Well, suit yourself. We have fought once. I won't underestimate you this time!

Just tell your friends to stay out of it. Let's keep this... between us.
h: I can't just stand here and wait, Eurial. You have too many secrets.

t: Get to the other side of the blockage and find out where the underground corridor leads.

We believe this is the finale of the story, !

We have been informed that the obstruction has been cleared. Which means it's time for the final adventure. We have to say We are tired of hearing the recounts of what's happening. We want to see it ourselves. We don't think We are in danger.

As for you, you need to save your friend. The orc that might become a Great Mage...
Welcome to my kingdom, surface dweller! Be happy you'll see it with your eyes before you die!
A long journey and an unexpected finale, am I right? You must have a lot of questions, and I'm willing to answer them.
Thank you for not leaving me there. I don’t know what happened there but I doubt it's over... But don't worry - trouble doesn't scare us, does it?

It's simple. To get to other worlds, we need Star Gates! But traveling between worlds is dangerous... The space is inhabited by creatures so hideous your imagination would fail to draw you a picture. We need a navigator for traveling between worlds. The one who will infallibly pick the safe path.

My experiments showed me that an orc would be a perfect candidate for the role. This race, forgive my frankness, is rather dull, but their intuition is rarely wrong. There's only one problem: the navigator must be a mage, and not just any mage, but a Great one. And the orcs' magical powers are lacking, as you know.

Then I remembered my Key of Creation. One of the artifacts Nihaz left in the world. By then, Grallon had the key, but you already know this story.

I got the Key and went to the Grok allod. The Great Mage Claude de Vevre was once a student of mine, and unlike the other members of the Conclave, he had a rather liberal view on what was considered forbidden. Together with Nemeina and our daughter Eurial, we chose an orc and used the powers of the Key of Creation and the Key of Chaos on him! The result exceeded our expectations!
h: What do you need Skulnar for?

t:
Of course!

Orcs are a savage people, and Lorzub the Fierce - that was our test subject - went out of control. It turned out he had a lover, and they were about to escape together. Alas, our attempt to get him back resulted in his death. By then, the Conclave got wind of what we were doing, and we had to leave Grok. Claude had the Key of Chaos.

Claude learned that Lorzub had a son. Alas, that line got lost among the Tribe of the Fierce, and Claude's attempts to find the orc who could wield magic ended in failure. Then the Shamans and the Empire heard of it. The Committee has full reports on what happened on Grok - when they killed Claude, they found his notes. But the Empire gains nothing by giving this information to the orcs - that's why they will keep calling it a "random astral mutation".

Before his death, Claude hid the Key of Chaos, and it remained hidden until Grok was destroyed by an Octulhu on the Night of Astral Portals. You know this creature as Ar Kanim. And then you extracted the power of the Key of Chaos, also known as the Key of Astral Iron, from its blood.

End of story? Not quite. Then I learned about Lorzub's descendants... Alas, they died fast. Faster then I could get to them. But then you and that mad Cosmos managed to get Skulnar out, and I'm grateful you did.

Now I needed to bring together Skulnar and dragon blood. Irene was perfect for that. I used my connections with the House de Vevre and made Caspar invite him. His Majesty Louis's help came in handy as well - he, of course, knew everything and saw it as an opportunity to get ahead of the Empire.

I don't care. I need Skulnar only as a potential guide for other worlds.
h: But something went wrong? Something always goes wrong.

t: Meet the most important guests of the Ball.

I give you Our most esteemed councilors: you already know the Great Mage Zayan, whose wisdom and knowledge are as deep as an ancient ocean. Her Royal Majesty, Lucretia de Desirae, the treasure of the court, the mother of my heir. Bianca de Desirae and Blanche de Desirae, Our beloved ones, official favorites, and my assistants. And finally, Renard de Ardeur, the Cardinal of the Church of Light, the Great Mage of the Lumenara allod. Antoinette de Delice, arch-duchess, the Great Mage of the Ignis allod.

Your arrival interrupted their conversation. I allow them to continue before finishing our talk.

Just look at them, .

Why must I always tolerate their fights? But that does it. Out!

I'll speak with my guest without annoying councilors. Our House, House de Desirae, has been leading the elves for thirty years. Over this period, we've made enemies, of course. The ones you've seen, the Houses de Ardeur and de Delice, are our friends. Other Houses are way worse. They envy our success and prosperity. We divide and conquer. This is the only way to hold everything together.

I'm tired. All We want is to have this one Ball without problems. We couldn't have it ten years ago. We won't tolerate any obstacles this time. I'm counting on your help, .

My poor daughters and I are doing everything to bring real peace to the unhappy, broken Sarnaut. But there are still those who want to ruin everything. They hide behind false ideals, they saw hatred, which bears the poisonous fruit of war!

Oh, my poor daughters! You were through so much! My babies... Aurora, Beata, Claire, Diana, Ellen, Fleur, Gala, Hermina, Iris, Justine, Laura, Maude, Nadine, Odetta, Pauletta, Renee, Sandrine, Tiffany, Ulrica, Vitalina, Ivetta, and... what was it... oh, yes, baby Zoe!

What do you want? Peace? Or a continued war with the Empire?
Talk to Elizaveta Rysina about the relations between the Empire and the elves.

At ease, comrade !

I suppose, Yasker has explained the purpose of our cooperation? Fine.

I want you to know that I don't hold grudges for that incident on the Isle of Revelation. My actions were unreasonable.

Here's the deal: the elves allowed other races, including the Imperial ones, including some Committee members, to arrive at Irene. We all will work as a team toward the goal we set.

Our task is to gather information. We need to understand the mood in the elven society. What do different Houses think about the alliance with the League? And there's propaganda, of course. Start with bribing the bards. Let them sing songs that humiliate the League and praise the Empire. Be a valley of plenty if you need to, toss a coin. I'll reimburse your expenses.
Mass culture is the best propaganda. Well done! Here's your reward.
Talk to Voisvet Belov about the relations between the League and the elves.

Hey, . I haven't seen you in a long while!

I think you've heard about our woes from Aidenus or Marianne, and what we're planning to do with it...

Marianne is a smart girl. Way smarter than our dumb clerics or war commanders. She understands that we'll either stand together or die apart.

Luckily, the elves allowed all people of Sarnaut enter this place. Well, the Empire too, as well, but we're allowed to come! We'll just have to wait and see who wins.

What do you want me to do in the first place? I need to know people's opinions. What do elves think? What do Houses think about the alliance with the League? And of course, advertise the League on every corner. You know what I'm thinking? Ask the bards to sing songs that praise the League and humiliate the Empire. Be a valley of plenty if you need to, toss a coin. I'll reimburse your expenses.

Excellent. Elves will hear a song. I'll plant the idea in their heads that the League is actually very good. Irene will be ours in no time.

Here's your money.

It's not as though I always understood the elves, ...

But they know how it's done. We're more used to hay, straw, and manure, and look at this neat place! I'd hate to say goodbye to the elves.

Unfortunately, House de Ardeur did not win. However, I would not declare mourning yet. Antoinette is not going to leave the League tomorrow, and peace... Well, we have already made peace. There is still something to talk about, what we can offer. We will discuss the situation at the Council of Governors. Besides, I'm told the Empire has its own problems.
h: The League was unable to achieve what it wanted?

t: To be honest, I look at this and see that it's all about women! Antoinette has enough daughters to seduce a whole regiment. They confuse and tempt everyone around!

Well, . Kobolds are one of the many problems we faced here. In our lands, this race is elves' loyal servants, but here... they're wild and unruly. Over the centuries without elves, they multiplied, dug a series of underground tunnels. They come out at nights, spoil everything, and scare people to death.

We don't have a choice but to sort them out! The best way is to find their so-called king and punish him for his arrogance, but he's deep in the caves.

I order you to show the Kobolds that there's only one true king on Irene!
Very well. The preparations are rolling ahead. We can't let anyone distract us!
Examine the western districts of Ker-Is and find Princess Daguta's memories.

. I have a personal favor to ask. It's about the history of this place.

After the Great Experiment, we found ourselves locked on allods, almost cut off from one another. I had a distorted and incomplete information about what was going on on Irene. We don't know for sure how it happened.

We have a chance to find out at least some of it. The death of local population caused by the astral created an astral echo, a number of ghosts, living their life.

Please, examine the location and try to find something out.

That's what it was...

I want to know who the stranger was. I have an idea, and I don't like it.

"Hello, my dear diary!

I'm Princess Daguta de Dernier. I'll write my thoughts, impressions, and other stuff in you.

Let me introduce myself. You know the name, and as for the rest... I'm a heir to my father, King Grallon, the last of Irene kings. Sadly, my mother died during the Cataclysm, which shattered the world into allods. Irene is now one of the allods, a lonely island, which is floating in deep astral."
Find the missing Harpy Constance and bring her back to the palace.

! It's so curious to finally see you after hearing so much about you! Yes, my dear son told me about you.

I have a request for you. My favorite servant, a Harpy named Constance, went missing. I sent her on an errand a couple of days ago, but haven't heard from her ever since. She's on my personal business... way too personal to ask someone else for help.

Please, find her, . She's in the city. I'll mark the spot on the map where you can find her.
What a mercy! I was so worried!

Yes, it's me! And who are you? The queen sent you?

Those vipers are keeping me here! Their commander threw me here. They didn't say what they wanted...

Listen, help me! When they caught me, they damaged my wing, so I can't fly anymore! Take me to the palace, please!
Hang the Royal Duel Restriction Decree on 5 bulletin boards in the city.

We have another problem. Duels.

Hostility between the Houses is growing before the Great Ball. My subjects are easily provoked. A lot of duels take place right in the streets of this beautiful city. One word is enough to start a duel, like one spark is enough to start a fire.

There are people who deliberately trigger duels, hurting others and looking for a fight.

Hear my will: from now on, I'm putting a ban on fights, skirmishes, and duels on Irene. The violators will be arrested and severely punished. So be it.

Please, hang the decrees on the boards in the city.

Good. It's our words plus your reputation!

We hope that the cheekiest Great Houses will change their attitude during the Great Ball.
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Social Manners quest.

, rest assured, we appreciate everything you do for Sarnaut. You are a legend. Your exploits will be immortalized in ballads. I'm not the only one that sees it. It's the leaders of the League and Empire - Zayan, Catherina, and Klavdia.

The society of Great Houses is rather conservative. Only old titles mean something to nobility. Even if the title bearer is an empty-headed nonentity. As a simple elf Louis de Desirae, I find it outrageous. As the king of elves Louis de Desirae, We support this tradition. I hope you understand.

I'd like to make you a part of our society. But you'll have to make your way from the bottom. I can issue a royal decree and assign you a noble title if you prove yourself worthy to the king. Therefore, we will do the following: you will win the trust of the elves on Irene by completing Our tasks.

After completing them for the first time, you will receive certificates of royal favor. These certificates will allow you to get a new title.

By completing Our tasks every day, and also the tasks of Our favorite Bianca de Desirae and Our royal chamberlain Henry de Desirae, you will strengthen relations with the House you select as your patron.

As your rank increases, you will have new opportunities, gain access to new places, and will be able to talk to people who have previously refused to speak with you.
Great. On this occasion, I hereby declare you my valet!
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Dueler quest.

, you've begun to climb our social hierarchy ladder.

You might have noticed that I inducted you into the military. It would be weird to make you a tailor and offer you to join the ranks of the queen's maids! Nowadays even noble elven ladies prefer a sword to a needle. This is why these days traditional male titles are given to beautiful ladies.

Speaking about your merits, We have no doubt that military exploits are what your heart desires. Further steps will take time. Be patient, complete Our missions every day, and you will achieve great things!

Let's discuss the House patronage now. You can take a vassal oath and vow to perform feats in the name of a House, which would increase its prestige. The House you choose will respond in kind. Prove that you are worthy of their patronage, and you will gain it. This will enable you to purchase very rare goods from the House.

Talk to Quartermasters of each House to know more. That's where you can take the oath of allegiance, too. You can also talk directly to the House head to take the oath. Like me, the head of the House de Desirae!
You have earned a new court title. I hereby appoint you squire!
My friend, you've done so little. Unfortunately, I can't trust you.

Dragon blood holds this world's greatest power! The power that allowed us to stop the astral. As an alchemist, I have spent years studying this substance. A long time ago we came to understand that their power... is not of this world. Just like the power of the Great Trees. They have a lot of things in common, but many things are different. Dragon Flame is the ideal eradicator. It destroys even non-combustible things. Great Tree saplings are strong enough to create new matter from the Astral. What do you think?

You did the right thing by coming here.

My House is famous for our knowledge of magic. We focus the practical rather than theoretical aspects of it. Our interests lie in the field of alchemy, the queen of magical sciences. There's no waving a magic wand and shouting incantations. Only a strong mind can comprehend it. Almost all popular recipes of elven potions are developed by the specialists of our House.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are skilled mountainfolk. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

Besides, we know how to synthesize the Unsteady Matter, which will come in handy if you want to reforge your armor. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
h: I want to know more about House de Blizare patronage

t:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are skilled mountainfolk. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

Besides, we know how to synthesize the Unsteady Matter, which will come in handy if you want to reforge your armor. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
h: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Blizare?

t: Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Play quest.

You're climbing higher, ! I heard your name on the streets of the city.

You can ask me: do these oaths oblige you to something? Here's what I say: our society is based on loyalty and reputation. There's a lot of examples in history, when oaths were broken at bad times... and the traitors could get away with it, but doors closed in front of them, and their old friends turned away.

I understand that you are pursuing your own interest. You have the orders of your own leaders, obligations to the Order and the guild. Another oath might lead to a conflict of interests. That's when you have to choose.

I'm not judging you. But don't forget about the power of the word and the possible consequences.
You have earned the Guardsman title. True noble title await! However, you need to work hard to earn them.
Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.
It's time to receive the new title of Guardsman from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Runaway Lover quest.

You might have noticed, , that the elven society is obsesses with the idea of the Great Game. There are plenty of bloody events, betrayals, and stabs in the back in the history of elves, but the Great Game is free from backstabbing. All violators will be declared outlaws and banished from the elven society.

The victorious House determines the foreign policy of the elves. Victories often led to unexpected turns and formation of new alliances. The victor of the Great Ball is determined by the common decision of all Houses. If there's the equal number of votes, the current ruling House takes the decision. According to an unwritten rule, the previous Great Ball's victor refrains from participating in the competition.

You will comprehend these simple principles as you serve the Great Houses and climb the ladder.
Wonderful! You have earned the first noble title. I can't help but wonder how high you can climb.
Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.
It's time to receive the new title of Chevalier from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Espionage quest.

Flying higher, ?

Each of the Houses shows their achievements at the Great Ball. But only something truly grand can earn you a victory. To win the Great Ball, you must come up with something that can affect all elves. A new spell or a great artistic masterpiece. Everyone must be able to say, "Yes, this is the thing that will change our lives forever." Sometimes the victor isn't that obvious. It's hard to choose a single one from truly unique achievements. This is when schemes, secret alliances of the Great Houses, and backroom conspiracies come into play.

The rules of the Great Game aren't written, but every elf, who grew up in a never-ending competition, understands them. Even joining an organization, the elves remember their own House. They're always prepared to do everything for the victory.

Don't forget about it when you come across other Great Houses here, on Irene
Perhaps I should give you a piece of land on the allod to strengthen your position.
Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.
It's time to receive the new title of Baron from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Race quest.

Going further, ?

Let's talk politics. Soon after the Cataclysm broke the world into allods, my mother decided to cut her ties with the people she blamed for what happened.

For many centuries, elves stayed isolated at their allods, but the time has shown that war can come by itself. The Grok invasion put an end to all ideas about our isolation. The current situation has thrown us into the Kanian embrace. But times change. This alliance is outdated. War over territories became pointless after the invention of astral flights and new discoveries.

Think about it.
Wonderful! Wonderful, as always. You took another step to the top.
Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.
It's time to receive the new title of Viscount from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Ice Dance quest.

The Great Ball, the demonstration of the Great Houses’ accomplishments - it’s all incredible. But even during events like these, We cannot forget about politics, so you shouldn’t either, .

As We already said, times have changed... Both Kania and Xadagan are dealing with new enemies, and the discovery of numerous new allods made their old wars pointless.

Let Us paint you a picture. In a situation where we have vast unsettled territories, reproduction of population starts playing a major role.

The Empire’s position in that regard is unfavorable. The Xadaganians that move to the cities do not have large families. Not to mention the Arisen who increase their numbers only when they find the new bodies of their compatriots. Which happens less and less often these days.

At the same time, big families are a norm in rural Kania. Gibberlings procreate rapidly. Over the last two centuries, this nation has increased its numbers several hundred times, even though there were very few of them in the beginning - they arrived here on a handful of ships.

Of course, elven families are usually small, too. Antoinette is more of an exception... But we live longer than others, except the Zem people who are immortal.

Only Orcs remain. Orcs are the backbone of the Imperial war machine. If it weren’t for Orcs, Yasker wouldn’t be able to nurture his expansionist dreams. He’d be worried about holding what he has.

That Empire would have been easy to deal with. And there would have been no need for the League...

Think about what We have told you. I wonder what conclusions you will draw.
Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.
It's time to receive the new title of Count from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Fairies of Irene quest.

, the Great Ball is nearing its end.  I hope you've enjoyed your stay on Irene.

It is also dear to Us, but We'll be happy to return home, to Nocturn which is still controlled by Our brother, Prince Gaston.

Nocturn, formerly called Yoggor, is one of the last shards of our original lands, just like Irene. The rest of our allods were lost during the Night of Astral Portals...

There were much fewer of them before. Andis, which was also inhabited by the Kanians... Nurrir, our former domain, our family's homeland. The majestic Uramesa of the House de Blizare... Fammon, the indestructible stronghold of the House de Ardeur, Grok with its endless steppes...

Our new allods Stellara, Tempesta, Ignis, and others have been discovered once the era of astral travel began. We tried to beautify them, but alas, antiquity cannot be reproduced. That's why Irene is so precious.
The title of Marquise will allow us to involve you in a more serious matter We'll be dealing with soon.
Wonderful! You are almost at the top.
Huh? Fine, fine... I'm having a good time so far! There is Caspar and Murk...
Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.
It's time to receive the new title of Marquis from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.
Earn a Royal Goodwill Certificate by completing the Great Ball: Royal Hunt quest.

, you have achieved the heights of respect in elven society.

Now everyone who doubted your merits has seen clear evidence that the rumors are true.

I hope you managed to learn a lot and came to a better understanding of our people, our plans and aspirations.

All that's left is to wait for the ending of this story. We are both curious to see how it ends.
The grand finale of your efforts is the title of Duke. Only the Head of the House is above it.
Yes, he'll stay alive and well as long as no one interferes. I wouldn't mind if you just stood there, but one wrong move...
h: What about Skulnar? Is he here somewhere?

t: Visit King Louis de Desirae's court on Irene.
It's time to receive the new title of Duke from King Louis. It may unlock new abilities and locations on Irene. You'll be able to talk to the elves, who didn't want to talk to you before.

Good to see you, . It's time for another title.

Life goes on. As you might have noticed, many events happened on Irene over these days. I suggest you look around the city and talk to my subjects to hear the latest news.
Speak to Great Houses' representatives on Irene.

I'm curious what my subjects think about the current state of affairs on Irene. House heads may not speak their minds freely. Those on inferior positions have nothing to fear. They can be more open.

Please, find your old friends in the city and discuss their Heads' plans. Find out what they are thinking.

The opinions you gathered are quite curious. As we thought, the politics of the Great Houses are very controversial. House de Desirae will be forced to give up power. The question is, which House will come next? If I understand correctly, every House has three rivals, but also three opponents.
May the Light be with you, !

House de Ardeur is one of the greatest elven Houses. We achieved much, both in glorifying the Lights and in engineering, making a fine example for other elves. Mirage and Galleon Castle are our inventions. Our leaders, siblings Renard and Marianne, are the Heads of the Church of All Elves.

Lumenara is our allod of origin. A bright lighthouse in the astral abyss, an amber-lit shelter for everyone who wants to change this world. Thanks to Renard, all our technical innovations are on this allod, and thanks to the power of Light, it's a truly safe place. We're not alone on the Lumenara allod. The Aviak tribe, our loyal servants, defenders, and assistants inhabit this place.
h: What can you tell me about you House?

t:
We respect House de Blizare. We share their passion to exploration and development of this world. House de Desirae are our old friends and allies, who helped us construct the Galleon Palaces. House de Pluie are our trading partners, spare parts suppliers, and supporters in spreading the teachings of the Church of Light.

Our relations with other Houses are not so light. House de Vevre are troublemakers. Too careless to rely on. House de Grandeur are incredibly arrogant, rejecting everything new in life. House de Delice... well, I don't even want to talk about them. Decadence and filth!

Every House has an exception. There's no painting them with a broad brush.
h: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
After the Yazes events, I decided to dedicate myself to theoretical theology. Yes... yes! I mean the Master we came across while storming the Gorluxor's Tower. I was especially interested in his Light Side. After all the events, it's very important that we understand the essence of Tensess's Gift. The data was strictly classified, but extremely interesting!

I can send you my work when it's finished.
Prevent duels between representatives of smaller races.

I've already issued a Decree that bans duels. I'm afraid it won't be enough! There are proud Aviaks that are very peculiar about the issues of honor. Although, maybe they just love to fight. I don't know. There's this ugly tradition of provoking fights after getting paid by the House. Aviaks fight lamias, Kobolds fight harpies, and so on.

They set a bad example for all other races. They involve elves in fights as well. We want you to patrol some popular dueling locations in the city. If you come across a duel, remind them about the royal decree again.

Hey, what's up? Are you surprised to see me? Ha ha.

Yes, you might have noticed, but this time not only elves are invited to the Great Ball. The king thinks it was right to invite everyone over to Irene. They want to impress everyone with their success. That's literally what they say.
Escort Constance and help her deliver the secret message.

Kharr! Khar! Bloody astral hell!

Enough fight! You show what you can do. You fight good, you brave... unlike that scoundrel! It is no time for fun. I speak with pretty harpy, she ask, you come. I need your help. It's urgent. Follow me! All for one, one for all!
Oh, my mistress... I'm so worried... How could this happen? There are spies behind every corner...

I knew I could rely on you.

I need to deliver this letter to the harbor. And I would, if it weren't for the damned snakes! They're following me around.

Please, help! This letter must be delivered to the right hands!
Find out why elves are after Skulnar.

They invited me as a guest of honor, hehe. The king chose me for my talent.

He says he knows the ancient legends about the Orc, who can use magic. It's kind of what he sees now.

He sent me here on a mission. His subjects need some discipline... but I don't know where to begin. They're all super unruly, fighting and killing each other all the time. That's why I'm still hanging around. And there are these circus magicians. They're giving me a headache.

Enough with the questions. The show begins!

Keep the mask, you'll find it handy. You'll see.

Until next time, . Until we meet again!

Ha ha! Ta da da dam.

How do you like this crazy world?
A flower will grow from a grain. You can make a mug from clay.
h: What do you want with Skulnar?

t:
Too many questions. It's boring.

Let's play. You'll get your answers if you win.
h: What does this mean? Who are you?

t: Meet Amis, Potis, and Atis in the alleyway near the pier.

Did you fail to catch that moth? I know! She's so skinny it's impossible to get a purchase!

Alright, whatever. I've been thinking, maybe, I should give acting a try. I could play the Princess's role, hehe. They will totally buy it, with my talent.

Oh, I've just remembered something. I stumbled upon someone while you were wandering in the city. Someone who? You know, chicks with rapiers... whatchamacallem... The Aviaks. They wanted to talk to you, and they looked like they meant business. All three of them. They came up to me in turns, and each wanted to meet you in some alleyway near the harbor.

Know what this is about? Make sure not to kill anyone. They're pretty tame. If you hurt them, their owners won't like it.

Go. I'll stay for now...
What's going on? Kuarrr! Stop it!

My dear !

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to postpone this task until later. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. This pause is quite welcome.

The problem the Empire is facing bears no delay. The matter is urgent and rather delicate.

I order you to visit me in Yasker's Tower as soon as possible.

Yasker mentions a problem in his letter. The Imperial leader wants you to arrive as soon as possible. Don't make him wait.

You have arrived. Good. The reason I summoned you is simple.

The Great Ball will begin soon. This event defines the elven policy for years to come.

Why should you care?

I'll tell you: we have a chance to weaken the League's position.

Let's look into the history. Kania and Xadagands have been opponents for thousands of years. None of them can win. Several centuries ago the conflict was taken to a new level: other races got involved. Orcs and Zem joined the Empire. Gibberlings and elves became part of the League.

The Arisen helped us develop science and technology and make a leap ahead.

But the League never lagged behind. They're copying our inventions and discover things on their own thanks to their well developed magic. Elves play a decisive role in this process.

We're on truce terms with the League now. But historically, no truce can last long. Moreover, thanks to you and the Cosmos, we have a problem with the orcs who threaten to quit the Empire. So far, it's just talk, but who knows what's going to happen.

What can be done in this situation? Try and weaken the connection between Kania and elves. How? Let me explain.
Greetings, friend! The prison is in perfect condition, the number of jailbreaks isn't any higher than in the recent years. I already sent an explanatory note about the incident with the elven girl.

My dear friend !

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to postpone this task until later. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. This should give us some time.

The problem the League is facing bears no delay. The matter is urgent and rather delicate.

I order you to visit me in Novograd as soon as possible.

Aidenus mentions a problem in his letter. The League leader wants you to arrive as soon as possible. Don't make him wait.
It's good to see you healthy and safe.
Find Marianne de Ardeur and speak with her.

"My dear , the hero of my people. Every elf knows your name!

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to lay down your arms for the time being. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. You will have enough time.

You are an outstanding child of our race, someone we all treasure and respect. It is time for you to receive your rewards for your accomplishments. And of course, to do something new.

I order you to visit me in Novograd Church as soon as possible."

Marianne de Ardeur wants you to meet her on a festive occasion. You shouldn't make the Prioress of the Church of Light wait.

Here's your invitation.

Let me tell you what else you need to do.

The Great Ball is just a part of the Great Game. The Great Game is the reason for living of my people.

Every elf acts for the good of their House. Those who achieve a lot, gain power and influence, and rise over the others.

You need to come up with something truly unique to win the Great Ball. Something substantial. Something that will be valued by everyone, that can make a change.

By the victor's right, the winning House will determine the policies of all elves over the next decades. Until the next Great Ball.
h: Tell me more about the Great Ball.

t:
Each of the seven Great Houses wants victory, of course.

Like in any other race, there are favorites.

Two Houses are leading the race: our House de Ardeur, and House de Delice.

Most importantly, we have different views on many issues. House de Ardeur supports alliance with Kania. House de Delice stands on neutral grounds. They believe that with the truce we can achieve a stable peace.

Each House, except for House de Desirae, has taken sides. We can discuss it later.
Make sure that the elves are released early from the prison and report back to Yasker.

The Great Ball is a perfect chance to change the elven policy. The winning House determines our diplomatic policy. If a neutral House wins, the League's position will be significantly weakened.

Luckily, that's something we can influence.

Elves invite you to take part in the Ball as a renowned hero. Besides, this time they're inviting different races... for propaganda purposes.

We can turn it to our benefit. I created a group, headed by Elizaveta Rysina, our official ambassador at this so-called event.

Report to her. We need to start with one thing. I know some underground crack houses in Nezebgrad, where corrupt officials and other scum gawk at dancing elven girls! It's time to put an end to it. We have truce with the League. Early release of all prisoners is on the table.

I order you to release all elven prisoners within 24 hours to strengthen our position. Complete amnesty! And transport them away from Igsh!

You're going to the Termitka prison in person. I'll give you the Order I signed personally. Supervise the release, make sure they're all set free!

Have you completed your task? Great.

Now the elves will tell everybody that you set them free in person.

This will increase your influence. You'll need it for your next task.
Oh Tensess, I'm sick of prison food.
Speak with representatives of the Seven Great Houses in Novograd and report to Aidenus.

Oh, this Great Ball...

It'll take a special effort to prevent the League from falling apart. The winning House determines our diplomatic policy. If a pro-Imperial House wins, the League's position will be significantly weakened.

Luckily, we can influence that. I'm talking about you.

Your deeds are impressive. The elves sent you a personal invitation to the Ball. Besides, this time they're inviting different races... to show off their gloss and glory.

Voisvet Belov, the Head of the Church of Light and the Kanian Warden, will visit to strengthen our position. Report to him directly.

I need you to do something before going there. Talk to the elves of Novograd, figure out their attitude toward the League. This is how we'll find out the general disposition.

It's curious.

Well, the elves are divided. We should convince them that the League is going their way. You and Voisvet will be able to find the right arguments.
Deliver the invitation to the Great Ball to the elves on Kanian Archipelagos and report to Marianne de Ardeur.

What a glorious Great Ball!

All elves are dreaming to visit! Luckily, it's held quite often, every few decades. I've visited many Great Balls in my life. I witnessed the ultimate victory of Maximilien de Blizare, who granted us a weapon against demons. I heard Estelle's prophecies. I tasted the triumph, when Romain and Celestine made a breakthrough in astral navigation. I saw the complete victory of Price Dakkar over Armando!

What will the celebration be like this time? We shall soon know.

Other races are visiting the Ball this time. We decided to show them the real magnificence and triumph!

And I want you to inform your allies and friends that accompanied you that they're also invited. I'm speaking about the elves of Kanian Archipelago. Deliver the happy news. Talk to them, ask how they are doing. They will be happy to see a renowned hero such as you.

You've completed my task. I'm sure you heard a lot of new things. Think it over. Make conclusions.

And now it's time to go.
Talk to Zayan and go to Irene together.

A history lesson is in order.

The oldest Sarnaut state is the elven kingdom of Irene. It existed back in the days of Junes, who began to build their empire.

Irene was a closed state and followed the principles of beauty. The elves didn't let anything in their state if it contradicted their ideals. Everyone who crossed the line was subject to destruction.

We don't know much about that period. At some point, the elves decided to undergo the change and turn into dragon-like creatures. The strongest mages of the kingdom managed to do it. They prepared the spells and put everyone in a magic two-century sleep.

Many things changed over the years. Junes destroyed most dragons and fell victims to the curse.

The elven life was significantly changed after the Transformation. They abandoned their old ideals... however, not all mages agreed to do so. The recent Conclave of the Great Mages was destined to split.

Problems with vampires, riots, and unrest in the kingdom made my people spread around the world, forming separate Houses.

I am King Louis de Desirae, Head of House de Desirae, Ruler of Tenebra and Nocturne.

Enough with the ceremony. I've heard a lot about you and your deeds. Welcome to my residence, . Your achievements put you on par with us, Great Mages, those who hold the world on their shoulders. By the royal will, I grant you the royal favor and the right to talk freely on any subject you like, as long as you follow the appropriate protocol.

The tradition existed before the Cataclysm.

The great feasts, where every House sought to overcome, transcend, and impress everyone.

In the beginning, the Conclave used the occasion to solve their issues. It was an honor to become a student of a Great Mage, especially the one that had lived before the Cataclysm. Soon, they began bringing other comprehensive issues to everyone's attention.

Everything was ruined after the Cataclysm. Many elves died. Those who survived under the Great Mages' protection, couldn't meet their kin from other allods.

The Irene allod survived. The last king had an artifact, the Key of Creation, given to him by the Conclave. The power of the Key was enough to support an allod.

Soon, a tragedy happened. The Key was stolen, and Irene disappeared into the astral. Grallon, the last king, used a portal to move himself and a handful of subjects to the Yoggor allod, supported by the king's distant relative, the Great Mage Gramon de Doucer.

Grallon was very old by that time. He didn't live long after that. Many claimed him as their blood relative. House de Desirae, the House of Grallon's wife, was one of them. But Gramon de Doucer took another decision. He restored the tradition of the Great Balls.

It wasn't visited much in the beginning. After a while, elves learned to create cheap and stable portals. The Great Balls attracted many participants. The old era was kicking in.

The leader was chosen in a competition. A queen's relative, the Great Mage Margo de Desirae, strongly objected. She declared herself the new queen of elves. From that moment, the House that won the Great Ball was considered the ruling House of elves.

You shall meet King Louis de Desirae, son of Margo and father of Prince Dakkar. After the victory in the year 990, House de Desirae defines the elven politics. Everything will change soon.

You need to appear before the king.
h: How did Great Balls come about?

t:
Take the gondola at the pier, and it'll take you there in no time. I could take you there, but Irene's legislation states that all visitors must come through the harbor. Let's not break the rules, shall we? Show your invitation to the Pier Keeper, and go. I'll go ahead to introduce you to the king.

I'll see you on Irene.
h: How can I find the king?

t:
Go to Al Rihat Ruins to the Patriarch's Residence and find the Great Mage Zayan to get to the Great Ball.

He'll instruct you what to do.

Talk to Elizaveta Rysina when you arrive. You must find a way to split the ranks of the League and make the Empire succeed!

And we meet again! I'd be very much surprised if they sent someone else.

I suppose, Yasker told you what to expect. So hear my historical point of view.

Go to Al Rihat Ruins to the Patriarch's Residence and find the Great Mage Zayan to get to the Great Ball.

He'll instruct you what to do.

Talk to Voisvet Belov when you arrive. Together, you should find a way to prevent the elves from leaving the League.

And we meet again! I'd be very much surprised if they sent someone else.

I suppose, Aidenus told you what to expect. So hear my historical point of view.

Go to Al Rihat Ruins to the Patriarch's Residence and find the Great Mage Zayan to get to the Great Ball.

He'll instruct you what to do.

Talk to Voisvet Belov when you arrive. Aidenus wants you to help him solve our common issues. I think we'll have to persuade the wavering Houses that the League is good for them.

And we meet again! I'd be very much surprised if they sent someone else.

I suppose, Marianne told you what to expect. So hear my historical point of view.
Meet with Antoinette de Delice in the Galleon Castle.

Well, ! The Great Ball is in full swing. We have already seen a lot, it's time to see what the Houses de Pluie and de Delice will show us...

We would like to talk to you about the last House.

Antoinette asked Us to tell you to come see her as soon as possible. After all, you were the one who helped her daughter Gala form this alliance with the vampires. It is time for the final act in this story of their fate.

You will find the archduchess in the Galleon Castle.
Don't keep Antoinette waiting, otherwise you won't have time to take part in the most intriguing plans for this evening.

! I'm happy to see you again.

The situation is becoming more and more tense. We all have to decide whether we will accept vampires back into our community or banish them forever. The fate of the House de Doucer will also be decided today...

Perhaps you are confused by all these twists and turns... I'll explain just in case. Annette is now the leader of all the vampires that agreed to the amnesty and stopped drinking the blood of sentient beings. Regardless of the House they belong to...

Roxanne, Armando and Carmilla's daughter, leads the remnants of those from the House de Doucer who did not become a vampire.

Gala, my daughter, will become their... defender at the trial of the Heads of the Great Houses. And now we have to decide what we'll say in their defense. Talk to Gala, find out what she is planning and help her.

Of course. I must win! Once I become the ruler of elves, I will change the world. I will make it better. It will be a time of harmony and prosperity, love and welfare... Together we’ll eliminate all threats and do the impossible...
h: You are so certain you’ll win?

t:
Hello again, . Renard has done well. When he’s not meddling, he can be very efficient. His creations will serve me... If my House wins the Great Game.
I think I’ll commission two more castles from him. Ignis is not as big as I’d like it to be, and I have a large family that needs space.
That was grand! I always dreamed of seeing Renard humiliated, and you managed to destroy all his arguments!
Winning always feels nice! I knew that our efforts would bring us victory in the Great Game sooner or later. Relying on diplomacy was a good idea.

Skulnar? Hmm... as the new queen, I'm concerned about the disappearance of people in my domain.

Then I'll tell you what happened. The three of you tried to get Louis to have food brought to the second floor of the Galleon - the poor man did his best to pretend he wasn't seeing you!

And then you started acting like you were riding something... What? What centaur? Ancient Moon? Here, at the Ball? It sounds like you weren't just drinking last night...

As a result, you and your friends were sent to some waiter... Where is he? Ah, there he is, near the entrance!

I remember you leaving the room and then returning with this waiter and food, but without Skulnar. I assumed he stayed outside to clear his head...
h: That's true... What did you see yesterday? Skulnar is missing.

t: ! Let me guess: your head is killing you, and you don't remember anything?

This is very touching! You managed to make a major contribution to our victory, and the fact that you voted for me... My gratitude will be eternal. If you need something, Ignis will always welcome you.
h: My vote has been cast for the House de Delice!

t: Oh, it won't be an easy choice... There are so many interesting things. I would even support Renard, but, alas, this is not in our political interests. Perhaps Guillaume? They used to paint me, too... There is "Naked Truth"... It hangs in the palace of a certain ruler, behind a curtain. Hmm! I will probably support Caspar de Vevre, his idea of the ensemble is exactly what I want myself! It's decided. House de Vevre!
Eavesdrop on the vampires' conversation in the Galleon Castle.

Annette and I are preparing a speech, perhaps Mother has already told you... But we are interested in what others think of vampires and the House de Doucer. This information will help us identify the best arguments for our speech.

It should be easy - just walk around the room and listen to what they have to say. I'm sure everyone is discussing our vampires... Try to learn the opinions of all Houses but ours.
Oh no, don't give me this look. Eavesdropping is completely normal in our society. No one will judge you.
So everything is still... Wait, what? Who was Caspar talking to...? What is she doing here? Huh?
Galleon Castle would be more beautiful if there were more statues. Nude figures carved in cold marble! And more paintings, of course!

To be honest, I was counting on a slightly different outcome! But perhaps we should look on the bright side. Peace contributes to trade, so we will get richer over time. It will help me win next time! Hugh suggests a new idea: we take the imperial Dream Factory, improve it, shoot stories, build mobile "theaters", sell tickets!
Help Skulnar feel at ease at the Ball

There are so many people here.

I'll take care of the final preparations for the trial. In the meantime, help Skulnar feel more at ease - I saw him pacing around here... There he is, to the right of the entrance!
Food is the most important thing at a party! Hah!
The musicians will entertain us! Ugh... I'm full... Murk is a decent guy! We can rely on him. Hey, come by tonight, maybe we'll find something to drink!
What, don't you know me? I feel uncomfortable, don't really know what to do around here... Let's go grab a quick bite? I don't want to approach the tables on my own!
h: How do you like it here?

t: Find eight pages of the lost records of past balls in the ballroom and on the second floor of the Galleon

Hey, you. Yes, you! You know who I am?

Listen... I have a problem. I am preparing an article on the history of the Great Balls and I've already written quite a lot.

I've lost my notes somewhere. I don't know how it happened...

Be a dear, help me find them... I think some of them are somewhere here in the ballroom, while the rest should be upstairs on the second floor. Please hurry! Let your intuition... or sight... or magic... Whatever it is you have, let it help you!

I think I dropped the first one somewhere near the drake of the House de Vevre when it moved abruptly...
Well? Have you found them all? I'm running out of time! We're going to print the issue tomorrow!
Excellent! Thank you so much! Phew! It's all here...! True, the corners are a little bent... I hope you haven't made copies and sold them to my competitors?
Take seven "hot" pictures of models from "Sharp Ears" at the Galleon Castle.

! Hey, buddy!

We haven't met, but I've heard a lot about you.

Let me introduce myself - Hugh de Pluie, one of the Tycoons. Yes, one of the seven most influential Free Traders.

Art is my passion. And beauty, of course. We are busy preparing the next issue of my magazine. No, this is not some boring collection of dusty stories... After all, this is the "Sharp Ears". Many in the Empire secretly read it... And not just the Empire.

I'm gathering material for the issue, but my photographer is late. Can you help? You have probably handled the Desorotype before.

Just capture the setting of the Ball. And my girls will help you create the right subtext for the pictures we will print.
Just don't stare at my girls. It might be a party for you, but for them it's just work.
Good pictures! Maybe I should hire you. We have a good market for that on Igsh, you'll be rich.
Convince the Great Houses to accept vampires and House de Doucer.

We've seen enough. Maximilien de Blizare, Caspar de Vevre, and Baudouin de Grandeur demonstrated their skills, everyone has already seen the painting by Guillaume de Pluie, the Galleon Castle of the House de Ardeur is also present...

It's time for Antoinette. She has been preparing for a long time and you assisted her. Let's see the result!
It is not easy to defend someone everyone hates... But if there is even a drop of faith in your heart, we will succeed!

It is decided.

Everyone is happy with the outcome, even the king. Although Renard is angry, vampires will serve us all.

We're preparing a speech for the trial! As the main participant and witness of almost all the events, you will also have to testify!

Don't worry, it's simple. Only Renard is against us, the rest of the Heads of Houses are rather neutral. We can win them over!

Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit... inconvenient details.

Shall we begin?
Participate in the vote and learn the name of the winner.

It's time for the final vote. The processing and counting of votes will be handled by the most impartial creature in the palace, the artificial intelligence of the Galleon named Celestine.

We are willing to trust Renard and Raymond, the architect of the Galleon, that Celestine will be truly impartial.

You only need to provide her with the votes of the elves - to do so, use a special compiler that will collect data. Progress!

You might want to learn what the heads of the Houses have decided - they cannot vote for their own House, so everyone will have to carefully choose their candidate.

Once you're done, return to Us to discuss your own choice. Yes, yes, you can cast your vote, too.
Soon we'll learn who will be the next ruler of the elves. Are you nervous, ? We certainly are.

Well, that was expected! We Ourselves chose Antoinette. Hopefully Renard will forgive Us.

The most important part is over, , but that doesn't mean the Ball is! The festivities continue! We think you should stay on Irene a little longer... You never know when something interesting may happen.

What?! And you came to me with this? Instead of setting out at once...?! That was the right thing to do! Haste without a plan makes waste.

Now listen carefully. The bad news is we don't know where the general is going exactly. And there's no time to find that out.

The good news is we know the local teleportation master, Sarang Ashturi. She has spent years on Ferris – she should know a little about everything that takes place there.

The second good news is Ivok's perception and Potis's eyesight. Ferris's landscapes are too... Vast for you to be able to find any traces on your own. So if you find out where the general was headed, listen to them.

Is your task clear?
h: We found out where the general went – it's somewhere on Ferris. Unfortunately Eurial followed him there.

t: Isn't it obvious? I'm the head of Irene intelligence and its only representative you will meet.

Finally someone good! We don't have much time, and we're running out of whatever's left. You must act as a carrier agent. Receive your assignment from the puppeteer agent and get in touch with their liaison. We have grounds to believe that he's the one that distributes the instructions among other working agent for the next 24 hours. Find out what the instruction is and return to me. They've got a lot of gophers. They'll hardly take any notice of you. Most importantly, you must follow the whole chain step by step from the controlling agent to the liaison without raising suspicion. Act quickly. If you take too long, you'll have to start over.

What do you want to know?
h: I'm ready to start my mission.

t: Talk to Skulnar, Kurgan and Sigurd to learn about the situation.

So much has happened over the last few months, I don’t even know where to start. I got myself into something and I’m starting to regret it. I decided to train orcs... But it went askew... Just ask me what you want to know, I’ll tell you. And... others wanted to talk to you as well. Kurgan, our shaman, and Sigurd. You probably know them, so find out what they want. And get down to work.
Have you learned everything you wanted?

That’s how it is. I like this place. It’s chilly but you can warm up near the fire. And if I feel sad, I visit my sister’s grave.

So, will you help?

It was great at first. I taught them what I knew, things were pretty quiet. Trouble came last night. I was asleep and dreaming when suddenly there is a loud crash and screaming. I spring up - my students are all shaking... Those black creatures appeared, and they started screaming, and I realize they are still asleep. I can’t rouse them - they are having a nightmare but can’t wake up. You’re quite an expert in dreams now, can you do anything? I feel sorry for the guys, I’ve become quite attached.
h: Talk to Skulnar about their current problems.

t: Chase away the dark offspring and revive three orc psionicists (Dumka the Big Head, Tolk the Brainy, Gaze the Nomadic).

I have a solution - as simple as an axe, hah. We’ve gathered them all in the tavern. Go there and take care of the vermin in the area, then try to rouse them. It should help. I’d go myself, but I’m afraid I might fall asleep, too. I guess you managed to cure yourself of that when you were traveling around the allods?
I still need to revive three orc psionicists (Dumka the Big Head, Tolk the Brainy, Gaze the Nomadic) and see what they know.

What? What were they shouting? Something about darkness? And everyone dying? I don’t like this. It’s probably nothing, there have been many doomsayers over the years, but these guys wouldn’t lie about that, right? They must have seen something. But what was it? Well, prophecies aren’t my thing, but our brother psionicist can usually see through time. We need to ask someone else about it...
Ask Elizaveta Barisheva, Sarbaz Segret, and Saad Tankha for a prediction
Well, what is it? Did you ask those fortune tellers what we should do?

You know, I understand even less now than I did when we first started this. What do we do? Pshaw! If we could just find one decent fortune teller who’d tell us: go there and do this, and everything would be alright.

You can find Barisheva in Eljune, Eljune Bazaar. You’ll see tents there, it’s like a circus.

She’s a wise woman, and she works with cards. I can only play cards, haha. But she sees something in them. Let her tell you your fortune.

Even if she doesn’t say anything useful, she can point you to someone who can.
Oh, precious. I knew I’d meet you. I had a prophetic dream.
Barisheva asks you to retrieve her divination cards stolen by bandits.

The road called me for a reason. I was worried after all those mysterious travelers appeared, predicting terrible things and confusing people...

And people kept asking questions. Wealthy merchants, young warriors, lovely maidens - all the Novograd citizens. Even Aidenus himself asked for a prediction. But cards were silent that time.

I gave it a thought - and decided that I needed a new card deck. They say there’s a rare deck created by an ancient master, the Wise Khima himself. And apparently you can buy it here, in Eljune. I packed my things and traveled there. Bought the deck.

But the reading was unfortunate. It warned me about loss. My cards were stolen. I don’t know who did it, there are plenty of thieves around here, each more suspicious than the last.

Be a dear, bring me my deck.
Oh, my poor deck. Damn those bandits. What was grandma’s curse?

Oh, precious. My vision is blurry and vague, cards are saying strange things. It only happened once to me, a few years ago when the mysterious Director was sending letters to everyone. It was a difficult time.

You chased him away, didn’t you?

I don’t know how to help you... But maybe...
Kill the bandits near the Eljune Bazaar

Oh, honey. Oh, dear!

Scoundrels everywhere! You can't take a step out of the gates without getting jumped... robbed and mugged... and if you're a woman - dishonored!

We live in an evil time, evil time...

The scoundrels are now rampaging here, in the Holy Land. Nothing is sacred to them... The bandits are roaming free right past this fence...

Please, be the hero you are supposed to be - kill them, I beg you!
Damn those bandits. Will you kill or get killed?
Ivan was right, you can't defeat evil with non-resistance. If the innocent suffer, if orphans and widows weep, what is your duty? Just pick up a sword, and go fight evil!
Oh Tensess, I knew it would end up like this...

Yes, everything is in order. Let’s see...

I’ll need to introduce an element of chance. But someone else has to do it, or the reading won’t be accurate. You will help me.

First, pick a number between one and three.
h: Can you do a reading with these cards?

t:
One. Hmm, very well... Let’s see what we have...

The reading is unclear. Alright, you need to pick one of the three cards. Do it quickly, don’t overthink!

Two. Very well... Let’s see what we have...

The reading is unclear. Alright, you need to pick one of the three cards. Do it quickly, don’t overthink!

Three. Very well... Let’s see what we have...

The reading is unclear. Alright, you need to pick one of the three cards. Do it quickly, don’t overthink!
What brings you here again, foreigner?

Greetings, foreign hero. I knew we’d meet. You want to help the elf? Are you sure he needs it? Ademar was the one who brought misfortune on his house. He brought that cursed mirror, so now he’s paying for it!
Brew a potion that can help Ademar.

We’re all architects of our own fortune. Yours is right behind you. Mark my words: if you board the cursed ship, you will die there!

The cure for the elf will be a bitter one. You’ll have to work for it.

Collect some Lotus for me. It will cure any sickness. It grows around lakes.

Then go to the city ruins. Collect some Strange Mushrooms. They restore memories.

But that’s not all. There are some corrupted druids in the area, the cursed sorcerers. The sickness drove them mad. They stole the tears of Umoir forests. These tears bring repentance. Retrieve them from the corrupted druids.

Finally, there’s a Brutosaur dwelling in the Covert Hide. When the Blight hit the land, the Mother Earth screamed and gave birth to this creature. Its liver is the last component.

Collect everything and mix the ingredients in the Totem Circle. Then take the potion to Ademar.

Farewell. Mark my words!

What? You didn’t understand anything? Prophecies are always like that. I need to speak with someone who can make sense of it. Whom? Do you know Zayan? Yes, yes, the Historian. What? You mean he can’t help?
Meet with Sarbaz Segret in Asee-Teph

You can find Segret in Asee-Teph in the ruins of Miktlan where the Historians' Camp is.

He’s technically dead but he still mede... meridi... ugh. Meditates! Yes! Falls into a trance and sees something. I hope he can help us. If not, ask him if he knows anyone else in the Empire that can. Their Council and ZIT Headquarters both dabbled in predictions.
Greetings! Some strange things are happening. Prophecies. Predictions. What does the future hold? I’m concerned. It’s not easy to separate truth from lies.

Residents of the Empire were frightened by mysterious travelers who predicted the future. The Council launched an investigation. They are gathering information and analyzing it.

Accurate predictions. My duty is to provide accurate information. Knowledge of history will help us. Background data: there was a nation known as June people. They had special divination tablets that allowed them to peek into the future. I traveled to the place where the Historians found these tablets.

Problem: the Historians are understaffed. Cause: some left for the academy opening ceremony on Ammer, others are studying Ferris with a group of explorers. What to do: collect the tablets ourselves.

Your task is to help me. I promise to share any information I might find.

Tablets collected.

Entering a trance state... I see. Hmm. I don’t see anything. There’s darkness all around me.

Interesting. This is supposed to be a prediction about the future of the Empire, and yet I see nothing.
It reminds me of the time when some Director was blocking my abilities. However, I’m not feeling any resistance now.

I don’t know how to explain this. Wait...

…

So. The Council has contacted me. You need to get to the Isle of Revelation, find a place called Granite Madness, and meet with Elizaveta Rysina there.

Of course, you can ignore that, but I suggest you don’t. After all, you want to know the truth, don’t you?
I’m glad you are here. I didn’t want to send Yasker Hawks after you.

Oh! It’s his fault! This will all happen because of that damned orc!

He won’t get away with it! The Empire is strong, and we won’t just stand by. We won’t let him destroy it! From now on, your friend had better look over his shoulder!

We should’ve never given free rein to the shamans! But they are going to dance to another tune now. I’ll make sure they forget the word “independence”.

As for you, choose your companions more carefully next time. He can easily drag you down with him.
Meet with Saad Tankha on Coba Plateau

The Priden is sitting on Coba Plateau in the Demon Hunters’ Camp.

To tell the truth, I’ve never had any dealings with their tribe, but I know they have their shamans and spirits, just like orcs. They are just called differently. And if this Saad Tankha is a shaman, let him tell you what he sees.

Hey, stranger!

I am Saad Tankha, the Priden Shaman sent to this allod by the doolgas who communicate with spirits and sages of our people.

Many strange things have occurred around here. The Doolgas saw a great exodus... many spirits left this world. Perhaps you witnessed it yourself. We are worried the same might happen to the Golases that have been guiding us for centuries. The troubles of the rest of the world usually do not concern my people, but what’s coming will affect all of us.

Our orc shamans learned that I was alive - rumors spread quickly, after all. Perhaps some demonologist blurted it out, or they had a vision... doesn’t matter, really. They came to me. Cried, fell to their knees, hugged me! Pshaw!

“The hope of the orcs is alive again” and all that. I show them the door, meaning I don’t want any part of that. They change their tune then. “How about you help us train young orcs with special abilities, Skulnar?” they say. And I ask, “What kind of abilities?” It turns out our shamans have been watching those with highly developed perception. Well, those who can predict the future. They are supposed to be the descendants of that Legendary Orc but they’re nowhere as strong as he was. It’s just a smidge - they are luckier in cards and can dodge a stray arrow.
h: Talk to Skulnar about recent news

t: Kill the vultures and collect their bones
Where are the bones I require?

Hmm. Unclear. The things I’m seeing have nothing to do with Howlem, our homeland. But it’s linked to the Pridens’ future. Are we going to leave our home?

I see gloomy forests crawling with hostile creatures. We are fighting them. It looks like the outcome of this war will determine our survival... but I can’t say who wins. The outcome is unclear.

I’m sorry. That’s all. Predictions can be vague or deceiving, eysh.

Aho, friend!

I have a request for you. See the vultures, the nasty birds that feast on the remains? Vile spawn of the hunhurrs. I do not believe that these birds are relatives of noble native eagles. It's some kind of mistake.

And we will correct it together, eysh! The vultures should not obscure the sky with their wings - they are simply unworthy of it. They must crawl through the mud like reptiles.

We will return them to this mud. With your help, of course. Bring me their bones as proof.
Truly, the elves were right when they wanted to make this world more beautiful.
There are fewer of them now. Good. But our work is not finished yet.
Rusted fragments sing dreadful songs of the past and future...
Meet with Cassandra near the Well of Souls.

Let’s think. We talked to all of them. And no one said anything useful. Just tried to scare us. We need someone better equipped to explain how we can avoid all this. Do we know any real diviner who can see anyone’s future?

Yes, you thought of her, too? Cassandra, of course! I caught a glimpse of her once when I was on Ammer. Well, if she can’t help us, no one can. She’s a Domina of Fates, after all. Let me try and contact her. Wait a little...

…

So. It’s settled. She’ll be waiting for us near the Well of Souls. Go there.

I’ve been waiting for you, Stormbringer. I saw this moment long before our first meeting. I knew it will come to be. Do you hear the footsteps of your destiny behind you? You’ve been running from it for so long, but you can’t escape it.
Learn your destiny using Cassandra’s methods

We all have a different fate. Remember how you tried to change someone’s fate on Kirah and failed? Your fate awaits now, Stormbringer. The day will come, and you will board that ship.

I saw the future. Mine as well. On the other land. Under a different sky. Your great-grandchildren’s great-grandchildren will be there.

Destiny can’t be changed. The day will come, and everything will be submerged in darkness. Only a few will survive.

No one will believe me if I tell them. You won’t believe it either. But perhaps you want to look into the Well of Souls? You want to face your Fate and try to beat it? Go ahead.
Have you looked into the Well of Souls?
Do you see? That orc’s fate is sealed, and so is yours.
Sometimes the Well calls to me as though it wants to tell me something...
Talk to Veronica, Sculptor, Catherina, Nefer Ur, Ollum, Zayan.

Do you think it’s all in vain? I don’t think so. We’ve learned something. Just don’t despair yet. Prophecy is not a sentence - if you don’t want to board that ship, you don’t have to. Look how many important people are here... Perhaps you should tell them what you know and ask for advice? Maybe we’ll come up with something.
So, have you talked to everyone?

I knew each of them would hold a different opinion. Perhaps one of them is right.

At any rate, we still have time. When is this going to happen, exactly?

We've found our way out of worse situations.

See you! I’m going back to Coldberg to train my students. If you need me, you know where to find me. Perhaps we’ll meet again.
Go to Skulnar the Fierce in Coldberg and learn what happened.

Another letter from Skulnar the Fierce. It sounds like our friend is in trouble, the message was clearly scribbled in a hurry, the handwriting is uneven. We must meet with him as soon as possible. Go to Coldberg in Swindlerville.
Phew, there you are. Finally! I’ve been waiting a while. Sorry, captain. I have serious problems right now. Help me out if you can.
Find Adramelech Lutov in the cultists' lair and discuss the situation with him.

Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

As you can see, demons are far from defeated. They are here again, preparing to strike. I'm sure this conspiracy has a base somewhere.

We have tasked our other agents with finding this base... I think it's a matter of time.

What should you do? Find our agent. His name is Adramelech Lutov, he's a rather... powerful Demonologist.

I guess you should follow your path until then. Let me know when you're ready.

Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

How is the search going?
Yazes was considered a dead allod. It should have stayed that way.

My recipe is simple and doesn't require delving into demon guts...

I suggest killing them until you run out of them. I think about two dozen will be enough for our troops to mount an attack.

After all, we are weapons against demons, aren't we?
Find Melchizedek Zavetin on the Twilight Isle and discuss the situation with him.

My friend, while you were gloriously fighting demons, I received a message. From Melchizedek Zavetin himself - he is a high-ranking Demonologist.

It looks like the cultists have another hideout on one of Yazes Shards. Melchizedek managed to infiltrate it.

The cultists are hiding something. I think he'll find a way to find out what.

If you happen to land on this Yazes Shard, find him. Let me know when you're ready to do it.
I'm sure you can find the cultists' hideout.
Yes, Twilight Isle is even scarier than Yazes Shard...
Find the key to the Citadel

The cultists have managed to build their own portal network. You need special enchanted keys to access it. Their power depends on the cultist's rank.

The highest ranking cultists can be found here on Twilight Isle, so we have a chance to find this key. I don’t know which cultist has it. I suggest killing everyone - sooner or later you'll find this key on one of the bodies. Then bring it to me.

Excellent. Well, I guess we'll part ways now.

We will look for this Citadel, and you... you follow the Lord.  I think there are many more revelations to come.

Sooner or later, we will meet again.
